Fantastic, amazing job. I am extatic. what a good patch you did! Apart from the power surge the game is ten times as fun, and the community is reflecting that.
In my last review i was skeptical, i just still wanted to believe due to sheer love to the game, its experience, the people playing it. and here we are.
After (finally) listening to the community feedbacks, and managing a community instead of a discord prison, this game is goty material. AA studios wiping the floor with the literal crap that we're getting in the past years from corporate driven AAA and AAAA dumpsterfires.

I was one of the most disappointed in the community about the unrelenting fun killing that was put in place in the last months. But yesterday i entered the game to see 50.000 people fighting in a sector again. and it felt .. su much good. You did good arrowhead.

The game feels again like a fine crafted product from caring developers, instead of a premium torture device. and while the enemies are still lethal and dangerous and we are still dying by the millions, it's working again. the formula is here. no more ragdoll festivals, no more unbeatable enemies that make you feel powerless: you are fighting against a relentless enemies, sure, but you have the tools to overcome the challenge. And it's so refreshing to go around and hear people calling you again "fellow helldiver", and speaking nicely at mics, instead of the usual "we are so screwed". This game has regained its strange power of uniting players in the experience.

One mission you can drop with all the possible permutations of a flamethrower, at melee range, basically brawling the world on fire, and the next one you can take sniper rifles and commands, sneaking around and headshotting left right and center, and the next one you can mechdive, and everytime it will feel as dangerous, and as mad fun as before. 
The arsenal, oh boy. Now you don't feel compelled into specific stuff. everything is viable, but differently. good builds will carry you far, but syncronized builds can feel so Badass that you ll be styling on your enemies. and that's refreshing, that's great!
The primaries, fantastic job. the support weapons, fantastic job. the mechs are now Perfect and i can't wait to see the lumberer enter the scene.
And the 500kg is now one of the most iconic things of the gaming world ever.

This game was purchased for me by a friend after I responded positively to about 1000 TikTok videos about it. It is easily the hardest I have laughed and the loudest I have screamed playing a game since I can remember. I don't care for insane, sweaty, ranked online games like COD or Fortnite, and this feels nothing like those. Its in-game mechanics and fun are more akin to other co-op shooters like Lost Planet 2, or some of the less serious elements of Halo. I recommend this game to anyone who likes to kill bugs, robots, or (accidentally) their teammates for hours on end, as well as anyone who thinks spaceships and explosions are pretty cool.
